When I was able to have a gas grill again when I bought my townhouse with a small back yard I purchased the 2 burner spirit thinking that it would never keep up.  I was so wrong. I've had a pork tenderloin, 6 ears of corn and a grill basket full of asparagus on it and it wasn't crowded. It's the perfect size without taking up too much deck space. It cleans easily with the Weber grill brush I bought.  I love that I can cook just about everything and the only cleanup is the plates we eat off of. I am 100% satisfied with it and highly recommend it. I also love the Weber newsletters I signed up for as it gives me the ideas and courage to try new things. The Weber app helps me with what temps and the time it takes to cook things on and has come in handy on many a grill night. Best purchase I've made in years and having a 10 year warranty on it shows that it is an exceptional product.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I have had this grill for less than nine months. The grill itself functioned as intended and is a solid unit. 

BIG ISSUE is that the plastic knobs are cheap and continue to strip out as you rotate them.

There are no metal or aluminum sleeves inside of the knobs so if you turn them just a little hard… They easily and quickly strip out. We are using vice-grips as knobs currently until we glean get new knobs!!!!

I went back to the hardware store where I purchased the grill and they said that they have depleted their replacement knob inventory because people are all having the same issue.

New knobs with metallic insert need to be quickly designed and added to any new Webber grills.
Results.Title: Good grill- TERRIBLE KNOB DESIGN

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
It's a very good grill, fast and even cooking and well made.  There are however two issues which I'm not certain whether or not they are the grill's fault or the way that Lowe's assembled it.

1.  The bottom of the gas tank hits the axel shaft which runs between the wheels.  This means that even when full, the tank gauge shows partial.

2.  The ignitor only works part of the time.  We mostly just use a lighter stick.
Results.Title: Good grill but

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
